proof_body:
by
  intro p a hp hp2 ha
  haveI := Fact.mk hp
  have hodd := hp.eq_two_or_odd.resolve_left hp2
  have hdiv : (p - 1) / 2 = p / 2 := by omega
  have ha' : (a : ZMod p) ≠ 0 := fun h => ha ((ZMod.intCast_zmod_eq_zero_iff_dvd a p).1 h)
  have key := ZMod.euler_criterion p ha'
  have h2 : a ^ (p / 2) ≡ 1 [ZMOD p] ↔ (a : ZMod p) ^ (p / 2) = 1 := by
    rw [← ZMod.intCast_eq_intCast_iff]
    simp
  rw [hdiv, h2, ← key]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨x, hx⟩
    have h := (ZMod.intCast_eq_intCast_iff _ _ p).2 hx
    exact ⟨(x : ZMod p), by rw [← h]; push_cast; ring⟩
  · rintro ⟨y, hy⟩
    have hv : (((y.val : ℕ) : ℤ) : ZMod p) = y := by rw [Int.cast_natCast, ZMod.natCast_zmod_val]
    refine ⟨(y.val : ℤ), (ZMod.intCast_eq_intCast_iff _ _ p).1 ?_⟩
    rw [Int.cast_pow, hv, hy]
    ring
target_source: ∀ (p : ℕ) (a : ℤ), Nat.Prime p → p ≠ 2 → ¬ (p : ℤ) ∣ a → ((∃ x : ℤ, x ^ 2 ≡ a [ZMOD p]) ↔ a ^ ((p - 1) / 2) ≡ 1 [ZMOD p])
